summary: YSX Tech Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of director Haozhao Lin effective May 6, 2026, due to personal reasons, and the appointment of Ms. Hua Wang as an independent director effective May 8, 2026. The board appointed Ms. Wang to fill the vacancy, and she holds a general manager role at Yangzhou Yuchen Seven Information Consulting. No family relationships or arrangements were noted. The changes appear routine and voluntary, not forced or abrupt. As a non-US issuer, this 6-K equates to a current report on Form 8-K for director changes. What to watch: no further special situation implications.
